decisions.reason: As a recent launch with some market presence but less visible public commitment than the others, management would likely keep it for now while treating any early weakness as temporary.
Because the firm gave this product its own page, it signals a stronger public commitment and invested identity, which under escalation of commitment makes withdrawal within the next year less likely.
Its dedicated website presentation suggests clear strategic backing and reputational commitment, so management would be inclined to continue rather than reverse course quickly.
